root.docs:
# AquaSuite - Combo + Register Customer + Login

Import Collection -> chon file JSON nay (Bruno native). Chon environment Local.

## Cau hinh
- baseUrl: mac dinh http://localhost:8080, backend da chay, PostgreSQL/Redis/SMTP da cau hinh.
- email: hop thu nhan duoc OTP, chua dang ky. phone: so Viet Nam 10 chu so, chua su dung.
- password: tu nhap secret cuc bo, 8..72 ky tu va toi da 72 UTF-8 bytes, co hoa/thuong/so/ky tu dac biet.
- categoryId: UUID danh muc ACTIVE dang ton tai. Phai co it nhat mot SKU NORMAL ACTIVE co gia duong.
- variantId: tuy chon. De trong se tu chon SKU dau tien co gia duong trong 100 ket qua lookup dau.
- fullName: ten khach hang test. otp: tu nhap ma email 6 chu so, giu so 0 o dau.

## Thu tu chay
1. Run folder 01: validation, register, duplicate, login pending. Dung lai lay OTP email (TTL 5 phut).
2. Dien otp trong Local, Run folder 02: activate account/profile, nhan JWT, dong session OTP.
3. Run folder 03: login -> refresh -> SKU -> create/list/get/update/stale/status/no-op -> publish -> storefront/evaluation -> unpublish -> soft delete -> logout/revocation.
4. Neu OTP het han: cho 60 giay, gui folder 90 khi tai khoan van pending, lay ma moi va quay lai folder 02.
Khong Run All collection mot lan vi OTP can nhap thu cong. Co the chay rieng folder 03 voi account da ACTIVE.

## Trang thai va du lieu
Token chi luu runtime qua bru.setVar, khong ghi ra environment/file. ID/version tu cap nhat sau moi mutation.
Collection tao account CUSTOMER that va combo BRUNO-* tren backend da chon; combo duoc xoa mem cuoi luong, account duoc giu lai.
Moi lan chay lai folder 01 phai dung email/phone moi. Folder 03 tao combo moi nen co the chay lai.
Response theo spec combo 0.12.0: list/get/create/update/status/publish/unpublish dung BundleResponse; DELETE 200 khong data.
Evaluation khong reserve stock va chap nhan UNKNOWN/INSUFFICIENT. Khong sua event, Inventory hay data SKU/danh muc.
Customer profile khong co API GET rieng; verify chi kiem chung activation/token qua hop dong HTTP hien co.
Neu buoc nao loi, dung runner tai do va sua du lieu/cau hinh; khong tiep tuc mutation bang ID/version cu.

## Import product Excel
Folder 04 chay rieng: dien productImportFile va productImportMode trong Local; login -> upload -> gui lai progress den khi ket thuc -> tai error-report neu can. Import ghi product/SKU that; OVERWRITE_EXISTING co the thay doi SKU da co. Folder nay khong tu xoa du lieu import.
